_note: Copy to data/boards.json. This is the list of company ATS boards arm 1 polls. Every provider here publishes a free, public JSON endpoint for its customers' job boards, so reading it is not scraping and does not break when a careers page is restyled. Arm 2 appends to this file automatically whenever it detects a board behind a company's careers page, so the registry grows on its own.
_note_finding_tokens: Open a company's careers page and look at where the apply button goes; the token is the path segment. boards.greenhouse.io/ACME -> greenhouse/acme. jobs.lever.co/ACME -> lever/acme. jobs.ashbyhq.com/ACME -> ashby/acme. apply.workable.com/ACME -> workable/acme. ACME.recruitee.com -> recruitee/acme. jobs.smartrecruiters.com/Acme -> smartrecruiters/Acme (case matters here).
_note_verify: Run 'jobbot boards add <provider> <token>' to add one; it refuses a token that returns no postings, because an unverified token polls nothing forever without ever failing visibly. 'jobbot boards verify --prune' rechecks the whole file.
